phrases.literal: When do you (plural) intend to give a return?

phrases.meaning: Good question
phrases.usage: Brief; buys time to think
phrases.literal: Good question

phrases.phrase: Eu me dou bem trabalhando sob pressão.
phrases.meaning: I do well working under pressure
phrases.usage: 'Me dou bem' (I get along well) is natural
phrases.literal: I give myself well working under pressure

phrases.phrase: Tem plano de carreira na empresa?
phrases.meaning: Is there a career plan at the company?
phrases.usage: 'Plano de carreira' (career plan) is the standard Brazilian term for growth opportunity
phrases.literal: Has career plan at the company?

phrases.phrase: Fico no aguardo do retorno de vocês.
phrases.meaning: I look forward to hearing back from you
phrases.usage: 'Fico no aguardo' is a professional but warm Brazilian closing
phrases.literal: I stay in the waiting of the return of you (plural)
